notes: Replaces folder-based cloud connections with Firefly Accounts: secure email or phone sign-in by password or one-time code, passkeys, encrypted desktop sessions, opt-in cross-PC backup and restore, and a 150 MB per-account quota. Sync covers music files, playlists, metadata, settings, artwork, favorites, and listening history. Includes the deployable Hostinger-compatible Node.js/MySQL account service as a separate beta release asset.
